sources.title: HKBU Chinese Medicine Formulae Images Database - Important Formula for Painful Diarrhea

value: Painful diarrhea associated with spleen deficiency and an overacting or vigorous liver.

Study clues include borborygmus, abdominal pain with diarrhea, pain relieved after diarrhea, and disharmony between the left and right guan pulses, described as wiry on the left and moderate on the right.

Stress-triggered diarrhea and abdominal pain support a liver-spleen disharmony study prompt, but the complete pattern still requires the accompanying signs and pulse context.

value: Differentiate the liver-overacting-spleen context from spleen qi deficiency diarrhea, where fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool, and a pale tongue are emphasized.
